meta.title: PHP2Shell: Live — product demo (hackathon submission)
meta.publishingContext: Silent caption-led judges' cut for Devin Hacks Kochi, 16:9 web embed + README poster. No audio track; every claim must read on screen.
meta.aestheticDirection: SOC Signal — dark operations-dashboard identity: layered graphite panels, hairline grid, cyan signal accents, amber vulnerability, breach-red, restrained kinetic typography. All product frames are real screenshots of the production build.

screenshots.intro-modal.png: First-visit intro dialog over dimmed inert dashboard (real capture)
screenshots.visualize-incident.png: Visualize stage 5 — 3D heap arena, corrupted/stale blocks, BREACHED status (real capture)
screenshots.forensics.png: Incident report + Forensics console strip with Inspector/Trace/A-B replay/Checks tabs (real capture)
screenshots.defend-actions.png: Defend phase — response action list with prerequisites, VERIFY REMEDIATION CTA (real capture)
screenshots.verify-report.png: Truthful PATCHED incident report, actions 1-6 listed, attacker DEFLECTED (real capture)
screenshots.multiplayer-lobby.png: /play lobby — ATTACKER/DEFENDER role cards, host/join (real capture)

scenes.purpose: Pose the problem: memory corruption is invisible until it's too late.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Tension — something is wrong inside the machine and you can't see it.
scenes.layout: Full-bleed graphite field. Top-left mono kicker 'INCIDENT FEED / CVE-2026-109619'. Center: one row of 24 abstract heap cells (labeled clearly: 'SIMULATED — ILLUSTRATIVE HEAP') filling left→right blue→amber→red. Caption beneath.
scenes.elements: Heap cell strip (24 rounded squares, border stroke only — explicitly stylized, not a UI screenshot); caption line 'A stale pointer survives an aborted request.'; label chip 'SIMULATED — ILLUSTRATIVE HEAP'; headline 'MAKE THE INVISIBLE VISIBLE' slams in at ~2.6s.
scenes.animation: Cells pop in with 40ms stagger (scale 0→1, opacity 0→1); cells 14-18 flip to breach-red at 1.4s with a pulse; caption typewriters at 40 chars/s; headline springs in scale 0.85→1 + blur 10→0 at 2.6s; ambient grid breathes at 4% opacity.
scenes.lighting: Single cyan radial glow behind the cell strip; vignette edges.
scenes.transitionOut: Cells scatter/dissolve as the real dashboard screenshot materializes underneath (cross-zoom into reveal).

scenes.purpose: Introduce PHP2Shell: Live as the product that makes this visible. Hero moment.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Relief + intrigue — there is a tool for this.
scenes.layout: Center hero: real screenshot visualize-incident.png on a raised surface card, tilted ~6° perspective. Left third: title stack 'PHP2Shell: Live' (display font) + CVE badge chip + one-line descriptor. Bottom-right: 'educational simulation' honesty chip.
scenes.elements: Screenshot card with hairline border + soft cyan edge-light; title 'PHP2Shell: Live'; chips 'CVE-2026-109619', 'SIMULATED TRAINING ENVIRONMENT'; descriptor 'A deterministic incident-response simulator for the heap you can't see.'
scenes.animation: Screenshot enters scale 1.08→1 + opacity + blur 12→0 over 0.7s, gentle settle tilt; title characters cascade 25ms stagger translateY(18)→0 + opacity; chips pop with spring at 0.9s/1.05s; light sweep crosses the card at 2.8s.
scenes.camera: Push-in 1.03x over scene; screenshot has its own slow 1.04x Ken Burns drift.
scenes.lighting: Cyan rim on the card's top edge; background glow orb drifting right.
scenes.transitionOut: Screenshot slides right and scales up as scene cuts to the Visualize walkthrough (momentum continues rightward).

scenes.purpose: Show the core feature: a five-stage exploit played out on a live heap arena.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Understanding — 'I can actually see the UAF form.'
scenes.layout: Screenshot dominates left 72% of frame at near-full height. Right rail: three callout labels stacked vertically, each with a thin leader line pointing into the screenshot regions.
scenes.elements: Callout 1 '5-stage incident rail — suspicious input → compromise' (→ stage list); Callout 2 '3D heap arena — allocation states in semantic color' (→ arena); Callout 3 'status pill: SAFE → BREACHED' (→ top-right pill).
scenes.animation: Screenshot slides in from right with parallax shadow; callouts enter bottom-up with 140ms stagger (translateY 24→0, opacity, blur 6→0); each leader line draws itself (scaleX 0→1) 100ms after its label.
scenes.camera: Static framing; screenshot does a slow pan left inside its mask.
scenes.lighting: Breach-red accent glow only behind the corrupted heap region of the screenshot.
scenes.transitionOut: Right rail callouts collapse into a single line that morphs into the next scene's tab bar.

scenes.purpose: Show evidence tooling: every allocation inspectable, exploit replayable.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Depth — this isn't a toy animation, it's an inspectable model.
scenes.layout: Top: four tab chips (INSPECTOR / TRACE / A-B REPLAY / CHECKS) as a kinetic row. Below: forensics.png screenshot occupying full width lower 70%, slightly cropped to the console region.
scenes.elements: Tab chips act as the scene's navigational motif; caption 'Inspect every allocation. Replay exploit vs patched runtime.' Mono text.
scenes.animation: Tabs cascade center-out with 90ms stagger (scale 0.8→1, opacity); active underline slides under each tab in sequence (INSPECTOR→TRACE→A/B→CHECKS, 500ms apart); screenshot rises 30px + opacity + blur over 0.6s.
scenes.camera: Subtle pan down inside the screenshot mask to reveal the console strip.
scenes.transitionOut: Whole frame dips 20px + dims as defend scene rises over it (depth handoff).

scenes.purpose: Show gameplay: real incident response — actions have prerequisites and costs.
scenes.layout: defend-actions.png screenshot fills right 68%. Left column: action list echoed as kinetic items (inspect → investigate → block → isolate → patch → restart → verify) checking off one by one.
scenes.elements: Seven mono action lines; each gets a cyan check-flip as it 'applies'; caption 'prerequisites enforced — only the right patch remediates'.
scenes.animation: Screenshot enters from bottom with scale 0.96→1; action items appear with 120ms stagger then flip to checked state with a 250ms settle each; a progress hairline fills top-to-bottom beside the list.
scenes.lighting: Amber glow that cools toward cyan as checks complete (containment metaphor).
scenes.transitionOut: Checked list compresses into a horizontal ribbon feeding the multiplayer scene.

scenes.purpose: Show it's social: attacker vs defender rooms on the same engine.
scenes.emotionalBeat: Competition — 'I can play this against someone.'
scenes.layout: multiplayer-lobby.png centered and scaled; ATTACKER and DEFENDER role cards echoed as two big labels sliding in from opposite edges. Mobile 390px capture peeks in bottom-right at small scale as a 'responsive' proof.
scenes.elements: Two role labels (breach-red ATTACKER, accent-blue DEFENDER) with a 'VS' pulse between; caption 'same simulation, live — host, join, or spectate'.
scenes.animation: Labels slide toward center from ±40% offscreen, meet with a soft impact pulse at 1.2s; mobile capture springs in at 2s (scale 0.7→1); screenshot ambient 1.04x drift.
scenes.lighting: Split glow: red left / blue right blending at center.
scenes.transitionOut: Labels split back out as the verify report slams into center (energy hands off to climax).

scenes.purpose: The payoff: a truthful PATCHED report — proof the lesson landed.
scenes.layout: verify-report.png hero at 62% width center; giant 'PATCHED' wordmark overlays top-left, cropped bold; action checklist strip along bottom.
scenes.elements: 'PATCHED' wordmark (ok-green outline + fill sweep); screenshot card; six check pips in a row labeled 1-6; caption 'replay the attack — prove the fix'.
scenes.animation: Screenshot scales 0.88→1 with heavy spring; 'PATCHED' slams scale 1.4→1 + blur 14→0 at 0.5s with a green shockwave ring expanding past the frame; check pips pop sequentially 80ms apart; subtle confetti-free dignity — a single light sweep at 4s.
scenes.camera: Slow push 1.05x into the report card.
scenes.lighting: Green radial crescendo behind the card; rest of frame stays graphite.
scenes.transitionOut: Wordmark drifts up; scene darkens to title card.

scenes.purpose: Brand + CTA: leave the URL and the one-line pitch.
scenes.layout: Centered title 'PHP2Shell: Live' large; beneath it the tagline; beneath that the URL in a pill; bottom edge mono disclaimer line.
scenes.elements: Title; tagline 'Watch a use-after-free form on a live heap — then stop it.'; URL pill 'php2shell-live.vercel.app'; disclaimer 'educational simulation — fictional targets only · single-player + attacker-vs-defender multiplayer'.
scenes.animation: Title draws in with per-character cascade + underline beam sweep; tagline fades+slides at 1s; URL pill springs at 1.6s with cyan ring pulse repeating every 2s; disclaimer fades at 2.4s; ambient particles drift upward throughout.
scenes.lighting: Cyan underline beam is the only strong light; vignette holds.
scenes.transitionOut: Hold last frame (poster frame) — title + URL.
